Subject: Redwood MAP & timeline question — MSA / DPA / Order Form dependencies

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement here — we need a quick mutual action plan that ties together: the MSA redline cycle, DPA review, and the order form data needed for PO issuance. Critical ask: can you provide the dependencies and earliest possible dates for signature so we can align our internal counsel and finance?

High-level constraints from our side:
- Legal can turn around redlines in 5 business days once they have your marked MSA.
- Security needs the DPA + SOC 2 evidence before IT signs off (they have a 7-business-day SLA after they receive the DPA).
- Finance requires final order form + invoice line items 3 business days before PO issuance.

Can you:
1) Share a simple MAP with milestone owners and target dates,
2) Confirm which doc we should expect first (MSA redlines vs DPA), and
3) Attach any template/order form fields you need populated?

Appreciate it — Marta

Marta Ruiz
Senior Procurement Manager
AlturaHealth

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Redwood MAP & timeline question — MSA / DPA / Order Form dependencies

Hi Marta — great to hear from you and thanks for the clear constraints. Attaching a working MAP (Redwood_MAP_ALTH_v1.docx) and our typical order form template (OrderForm_Templates.xlsx).

Short answers:
- Priority doc: we typically circulate the MSA with our preferred redlines first — that starts the legal gating path.
- Parallel path: we can send the DPA in parallel; security often reviews the DPA while legal is redlining the MSA. That usually shortens the critical path.

Proposed milestone cadence (high level):
- Day 0 (today): Redwood sends MSA (v2) + MAP (attached).
- Day 1: Your legal ack and initial read; security receives DPA (we’ll send DPA concurrently).
- Day 4–7: Legal redlines returned (5 business days typical per your note).
- Day 8–12: Redwood legal reviews and finalizes redlines.
- Day 13–15: Signatures on MSA/DPA and finance finalizes order form for PO.

I want to loop in our legal and product to confirm the exact buffer windows — cc’d Kimberly (Legal) and Aditya (Sales/Product) to confirm resource availability and any required evidence artifacts.

Next steps: Kimberly, can you confirm the internal legal review SLA and whether any clauses will need extended negotiation (e.g., data residency, audit rights)? Aditya, I’ll need the exact invoice line items we should prefill on the order form.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Strategic Account Executive
Redwood Inference

- Legal turns redlines in 5 business days.

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood MAP & timeline question — MSA / DPA / Order Form dependencies

Vanessa — thanks for the context. Quick legal gating notes below (high level):

Likely multi-cycle clauses:
- Liability cap / indemnity: Expect 1–2 cycles if Altura requests industry-specific language; if they insist on unlimited liability for certain claims we’ll escalate — adds 3–5 business days.
- Data residency / cross-border transfer: If Altura requires EU-only residency or specific contractual addenda, add 7–10 business days.
- Audit rights / on-site audits: Negotiation typically adds 3–7 business days depending on scope.

DPA / Security evidence:
- We should send the executed (standard) DPA template immediately — security can start their checklist with that and a link to our SOC 2 report.
- Attachments to provide: SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf, Encryption_and_KeyManagement.md (we’ll drop both in the shared Drive).

Suggested MAP adjustments (to make timeline realistic):
- Build a parallel lane for Security (DPA + SOC2) so security review completes while legal is redlining MSA.
- Add a contingency window of 5 business days specifically for "Liability cap escalation" in case counterparty insists.

On the proposed canary sign date (2026-11-18): optimistic but feasible if:
1) Altura returns MSA redlines within 5 business days (by 2026-11-11),
2) Redwood legal has 3 business days to review/resolve items (by 2026-11-16), and
3) Finance receives final order form by 2026-11-15 to issue PO on 2026-11-18.

If any of those slip, push target one week.

I’ll attach a redline-ready MSA (Redwood_MSA_v2_redlines.pdf) and a cleaned MAP with contingency lanes. Vanessa — can you confirm who will own order form prefill? Aditya, please confirm invoice line items.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference
